data.name: Indignum
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the World of Elador

You were born of the Temple, yet deemed unworthy to lead it. They left you for dead. But in the shadows of Elador, the banished princess rises.

Indignum is a challenging open-world action adventure that throws you into a realm of brutal conflict. Wield the power of the four elements, master a precise parry-based combat system, and carve your own path back to the throne that was stolen from you.

Combat Where Precision Meets Power

Combat in Indignum is a deadly dance of steel and spirit. Face ruthless enemies that demand focus and quick reflexes. Your blade is your shield, and your mastery of the elements is your greatest weapon.

  • Parry-Based Duels: Channel your inner warrior with a combat flow that rewards precision over spamming. Time your parries perfectly to break your opponent's stance and leave them vulnerable to a devastating counter-attack.

  • Master the Four Elements: Stop being just a sword-swinger. Unleash the power of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air. Set your foes on fire, ride gusts of wind to gain a tactical advantage, or hurl boulders to stagger approaching enemies. The world reacts to your power.

  • Fast-Paced Encounters: Stay mobile. Every fight, from a simple foot soldier to a massive dungeon mini-boss, is designed to keep you on your toes.

From Outcast to Heir

Your journey is more than just a fight for survival; it is a fight for redemption and truth.

  • Uncover the Conspiracy: You were not just a failure; you were a liability. Dig deep into the Temple's dark history to discover why they really wanted you gone.

  • Conquer Dungeons: Scattered across Elador are ancient shrines and forgotten dungeons. Inside, you won't just find combat trials, but environmental puzzles that will test your wits and reward you with powerful upgrades and elemental knowledge.

The Temple thinks you are dead.

The people have forgotten your name.

The throne is empty.

It is time to remind them why you were born to sit on it!

data.short_description: Indignum is an open-world action adventure game where mastery of the blade meets the power of the elements. Wield fast-paced, parry-based combat and harness fire, water, earth, and air to survive the wilds of Elador. Forge your destiny and claim the throne that is rightfully yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: 64-bit Quad Core CPU or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 980 or higher
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 64-bit Quad Core CPU or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070 or higher
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required
